name: Software placed by what it does: mathematics in Metrologic, agents in FeltOS, ordinary computing in the computer-system engine
asks: If it is ABOUT DOING MATH / IT GOES IN METROLOGIC / IF IT IS ABOUT DOING AGENT SHIT / IT GOES IN FELTOS / IF IT IS ABOUT ACTUAL JUST NORMAL FUCKING COMPUTING / IT GOES IN / services/engineering-services-section/services/computer-engineering-services-section/services/computer-systems-engineering-services-section/apps/computer-system-engine/ [...] MOVE THE CODE / FROM WHERE IT IS / TO WHERE IT NEEDS TO GO / SUCH THAT / THIS ONE PACKAGE ENDS UP ENTIRELY FUCKING GONE / AND ITS CODE ENTIRELY FUCKING ELSEWHERE

x-provenance.recorded-by: Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass obsmetrologia-math of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The Leader's utterances cited below, read in full. The asks field quotes them; the requirements are their EARS rendering and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Every software capability sits in the one package whose name says what it does, so that each is found in one place and none is carried twice.

requirements.says: Each software capability that does mathematics shall live in Metrologic, each that does agent work shall live in FeltOS, and each that does ordinary computing shall live in the computer-system engine at computer-systems-engineering-services-section/apps/computer-system-engine.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "If it is ABOUT DOING MATH IT GOES IN METROLOGIC / IF IT IS ABOUT DOING AGENT SHIT IT GOES IN FELTOS / IF IT IS ABOUT ACTUAL JUST NORMAL FUCKING COMPUTING IT GOES IN .../computer-systems-engineering-services-section/apps/computer-system-engine/" (2026-09-22)

requirements.says: The house shall hold no computer-data engine; each capability formerly in it shall be rewritten into the package R1 names, and the data section shall hold data and its codecs, not a system.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "how the FUCK can we have a computer-data-engine / data cannot be a system on its own / this IS (probably) our comptuer-system-engine"; "THIS ONE PACKAGE ENDS UP ENTIRELY FUCKING GONE AND ITS CODE ENTIRELY FUCKING ELSEWHERE"; "if compute-data-engine has bilattice-charge ... it probably has a BUNCH of shit it shouldn't, because it is literally JUST meant to be for working with *computer data*" (2026-09-21, 2026-09-22)

requirements.says: The house's engines shall carry no TypeScript.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "part of what I told you was: no typescript. WHY IS THIS SO MUCH TYPESCRIPT." (2026-09-22)

requirements.says: FeltOS shall have no kernel; it shall import its ancestors' capabilities and compose them.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "FeltOS shouldn't ahve a kernel ... it shuold ... import its ancestors capabilities and compose them into FeltOS"; "I have said 'feltos shoudl not ahve a kernel' like 20 times this session." (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: FeltOS shall depend on Metrologic for its mathematics and hold no mathematics of its own.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "FeltOS should have Metrologic as a dependent for math" (2026-09-21)

requirements.says: The house shall hold no separate jsnode-server, markdown-vault or lean-lsp package; their capabilities shall live in the packages R1 names.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "you aren't supposed to have jsnode-server, or markdown-vault, or lean-lsp" (2026-09-11)

requirements.says: The jsnode engine shall sit downstream of the computer-system engine, under the computer-systems engineering section and not under computer code.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "we did discuss making jsnode-engine downstream of computer-system-engine and moving it to the appropriate subdirectory out of comptuer-code" (2026-09-22)

requirements.says: A code-development engine under the computer-systems engineering section shall apply code changes, including codemod effects and git operations, to files.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "there shuold be a code-development-engine, or platform,, under computer-systems-engienering", answering who runs codemods' effects and git operations (2026-09-23)

requirements.says: Most of the house's software shall be written as FeltOS modules under the computer code systems, built on Metrologic and the agent organization engine stack.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "most of our stuff shuold be under computer code systems, written as feltos modules, using metrologic and our agentic relational engine stack" (2026-09-23)

requirements.says: The house shall keep phoss-in-a-box as a listed application.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "do not delete phoss-in-a-box, that was a legitimate application I never listed!!!" (2026-09-22)

requirements.says: Agent-harness capabilities shall live either in the agent-harness engine of their agent type or in the generic inference engine.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "any agent-harness stuff should be either part of the agent-harness-engine for that specific agent type or part of our generic inference-engine." (2026-09-24)

requirements.says: Wit and its sibling modules shall live in MetroPlat or the inference engine, whichever the specification shows owns them.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "wit et al are probably part of metroplat, or inference-engine, orrsimilar." (2026-09-24)

requirements.says: MetroPlat shall hold only the capabilities of an enterprise platform above FeltOS, and each other capability now in it shall move to its owning package.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "most critical is right now MetroPlat handles a LOOOT of stuff that it shouldn't" (2026-09-24)

requirements.says: The capability of allocate-attention-over-obstructions.mjs shall be rewritten into Metrologic, FeltOS or the agent organization engine by what it does, and the script shall leave the agent computer system section.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "allocate-attention-over-obstructions.mjs this sounds like it's some metrologic shit, or maybe feltos shit, or maybe agentic relation engine shit" (2026-09-22)

requirements.says: The notes in the agent-computer-platform section's content shall be held by their owners: science notes, such as those on OpenClaw, at the science sections, and engineering notes, such as the one on FARS, at engineering.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Some of these notes are owned by science, like the ones about openclaw, and others are for engineering, like the one about FARS" (2026-09-22)

requirements.says: SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph, SignLang and SignCraft shall be the paraconsistent, transfinitely valued linear-logic systems on which the house's computer runs, and the agent organization engine, FeltOS and MetroPlat shall build on them in that order to give enterprise actors their library.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "SignStuff (Cell, Chain, Graph, Lang, and Craft) are meant to be the underlying paraconsistent transfinitely valued linear logic systems that provide that computer, flowing outward through AOE to feltos to metroplat providing our library for enterprisal actors." (2026-10-03)

conditions.says: The specification of one implementation and placement is held.
No TypeScript source is tracked under the computer-systems engineering apps.

conflicts: R4: older notes, such as the 2026-08-16 molt-ledger capability audit, speak of 'the FeltOS kernel' approvingly; R4 supersedes them.
R16: SignLang is named by the Leader but no SignLang package exists; the 2026-10-02 note on offices to the cast proposes it as SignStuff's fifth library.
R6: markdown-vault-services-section still exists under the computer text data section.
